narrative:
Holmes County has 17,516 registered voters, with 12.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 39.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 46.5%, a clear Democratic lean of 7.2 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.8% of registrants.
